title: Add strikethrough and task lists
prompts:
Add two GitHub-style features to mdlite and test them. 1. Strikethrough: `~~text~~` renders as `text`, and it nests with the other inline markup. The opening `~~` must not be followed by whitespace and the closing `~~` must not be preceded by whitespace; a lone `~`, `~~ spaced ~~` and an unclosed `~~` stay literal text. A backslash escapes it, and code spans and fenced code keep their tildes. 2. Task lists: a list item whose text starts with `[ ] ` or `[x] ` (also `[X] `) renders its checkbox first. Unchecked: `
  • text
    • `; checked: `
  • text
    • `. It works in bullet and ordered lists and with nested lists and inline markup. A bracket pair that is not followed by a space (`[x]no`, `[]`, `[ab]`) is ordinary text. Add tests under test/ and run the whole suite.
notes: Needs coordinated edits in the inline scanner, the list parser and the HTML renderer (a 500-line file). Exact output strings are in the prompt.
